summary_en: Full-year dividend forecast raised by 1 yen to 91 yen per share (interim 45 yen, year-end 46 yen) for the fiscal year ending March 2027, reflecting upward revision of profit forecasts on stronger-than-expected sales and improved profitability.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Business Forecast and Revision (Increase) of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
Fuso Pharmaceutical Industries revised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, to 91 yen per share, an increase of 1 yen from the previous forecast. The revised payout consists of an interim dividend of 45 yen per share and a year-end dividend of 46 yen per share (increased from the previously forecast 45 yen). This modification accompanies an upward revision of profit forecasts for the fiscal year, with the company expecting sales to exceed the prior forecast due to continued strong sales momentum observed in the first half. Operating profit, recurring profit, and net income are all now projected to exceed previous estimates, supported by first-half performance, although the company anticipates increased research and development expenses and potential raw material cost pressures in the second half stemming from Middle East-related geopolitical situations.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's stated principle of providing continuous and stable dividends to shareholders while maintaining adequate retained earnings. The company's medium-term management plan, 'FUSO Vision 2030 Next Stage,' targets progressive dividend increases through fiscal 2030 while balancing investment in supply chain strengthening and growth areas with shareholder returns. The board of directors approved this dividend revision on November 11, 2026, and the payout is scheduled to be submitted for approval at the 104th ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for late June 2027.
